headline: Bearman's Haas deal is held up over salary, Motorsport.com reports
body: Oliver Bearman is the only driver on the grid without a 2027 contract. Motorsport.com reports the delay is over the salary Haas has offered, not his future, and that Ferrari has already exercised its option on him. Bearman has said there is zero chance of him racing elsewhere in 2027.

headline: F1 plans a two-team supply limit per engine maker from 2030
body: Each of the six 2030 power unit manufacturers would supply two teams, its own included, under the framework behind the V8 rules. Autosport reports that would leave two of Mercedes' three customers, McLaren, Williams and Alpine, needing a new supply if the World Motor Sport Council approves it in Shanghai next month.
